title: SBI Bank of Mahrashtra Prime credit card

cardOverview.overviewText: The SBI Bank of Maharashtra Prime credit card offers a balance of rewards and lifestyle benefits, providing cashback on select categories and access to exclusive offers, perfect for regular users seeking added perks.

benefitRows.name: Avis
benefitRows.offer: Up to 35% off on Avis car rentals.
benefitRows.howToAvail: To avail this benefit, book car rentals on the Avis website or app using your credit card to get up to 35% discount. Contact SBI customer care at 1800 180 1290 for help.

benefitRows.name: Hertz
benefitRows.howToAvail: To avail this benefit, book car rentals via the Hertz website or app. Use your credit card at checkout to get 10% off. For assistance, contact SBI customer care at 1800 180 1290.
